The direct acquisition matched native SHA-256 507fc51c1c711cf4827d8b89bdc773b70644b1dcee5c2cd5fa11c196af5205b7 and the recorded exact HTML ranges. Inspected the cited rule or publisher declaration at Core 1.0 §5.5.15, Modules, preamble prose, ordering clause and binary production. WebAssembly Core 1.0 encodes a binary module with magic bytes `00 61 73 6D` and version bytes `01 00 00 00`, followed by sections. Noncustom sections occur at most once in the prescribed order. Custom sections may occur anywhere in that sequence. This is the binary grammar in the December 2019 Recommendation. The numeric binary version field does not identify every subsequent language edition. The production agrees with the prose on magic and version. A repeated or reordered noncustom section breaches the grammar, while intervening custom sections are permitted and the grammar separately checks function/code cardinality.
